Data File(s): File 1 (Long): one row per patient per ventilator day; flowsheet reference flags
Analysis Question: When flowsheet documents SAT or SBT happened, does the algorithm detect it?
Primary Method: Sensitivity / specificity / PPV / NPV against nurse-flowsheet reference
Secondary Methods: BCa bootstrap clustered by hospitalization for 8 metrics

Data File(s): File 1 (Long) for discrete-time model; File 2 (Wide) for survival and competing-risk models
Analysis Question: When algorithm-applied SAT/SBT occurs, do patients get off the ventilator faster?
Secondary Methods: Cox cause-specific and Fine-Gray subdistribution sensitivity models

Analysis Question: Do patients who receive more SAT/SBT have more days alive and off ventilator?
Primary Method: Two-part mixed-effects model: alive at 28 days plus negative binomial among survivors

Analysis Question: Do patients who receive SBT/SAT have shorter ICU stays and lower mortality?
Primary Method: Zero-truncated negative binomial for ICU LOS plus mixed-effects logistic mortality model

Analysis Question: Which hospitals deliver SAT/SBT at high vs low rates after case-mix adjustment?
Primary Method: Risk-adjusted GLMM hospital rates with BLUPs
Secondary Methods: Median odds ratio / VPC / ICC / CCC / Bland-Altman / caterpillar and funnel plots
